This comparison evaluates Indicator 5, which tracks the proportion of patients receiving treatment with [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (BMSL) who have their fecal [[calprotectin|calprotectin]] measured at least once a year [^src1]. The data provides a snapshot of performance across national, regional, and departmental levels in Denmark, measuring adherence to a stated development target of ≥80% [^src1]. Because the provided tabular evidence consists of a single dated section from 2024, no longitudinal trends can be definitively established from this table alone; however, comprehensive methodologies, national overviews, and historical departmental data for the Danish IBD registry are documented across the 2023 and 2024 annual reports [^src2][^src3][^src4][^src5][^src6][^src7][^src8].

**Leaders and Trailers**
At the top of the comparison, several pediatric departments achieve a perfect 100% measurement rate, including SUH Roskilde Pædiatri, OUH Odense Børne- og Ungeafdeling H, and SLB Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling [^src1]. Hvidovre Børne- og Ungeafdeling follows closely at 98% [^src1]. Among the regions, Sjælland leads with 94%, while Nordjylland achieves 92% [^src1]. 

Conversely, the lowest-performing department is Rigshospitalet Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd., which recorded a mere 16% [^src1]. Other notable trailers include Aarhus Lever-, Mave- og Tarmsygd. at 59%, and both Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd. and Horsens Medicinsk Afdeling at 69% [^src1].

**Targets Met and Missed**
The national average stands at 83%, indicating that the overarching ≥80% target is met on a macro level [^src1]. Regionally, Sjælland (94%), Nordjylland (92%), and Syddanmark (84%) successfully meet the threshold, whereas Hovedstaden (79%) and Midtjylland (77%) fall just short [^src1]. At the departmental level, numerous adult gastroenterology and medical units miss the 80% target, most strikingly Rigshospitalet Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd. (16%), Aarhus Lever-, Mave- og Tarmsygd. (59%), and OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S (74%) [^src1].

**Outliers**
A distinct structural outlier pattern emerges when comparing pediatric and adult departments. Pediatric units consistently score between 97% and 100%, acting as strong positive outliers [^src1]. In stark contrast, Rigshospitalet Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd. acts as a severe negative outlier at 16%, significantly dragging down the Hovedstaden region's overall average to 79% [^src1]. Additionally, the final column in the dataset—which records lower values for several departments, such as 14 for Rigshospitalet and 56 for SLB Vejle Medicinsk Afdeling—suggests a prior baseline or alternative metric where performance was even weaker in specific units [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter med BMSL-behandling, der har fået målt fæces calprotectin mindst én gang årligt, på nationalt, regionalt og afdelingsniveau, hvor landsgennemsnittet er 83 %, men med store variationer fra 14 % (Rigshospitalet) til 100 % (flere pædiatriske afdelinger), og hvor nogle afdelinger falder under udviklingsmålet på ≥80 %.
